artworks.title: Bust of an Old Woman in a Furred Cloak and Heavy Headdress
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn and Studio of Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a person, depicted from the chest upwards, in a three-quarter view facing to the right. The subject has an aged face with facial lines and a slightly furrowed brow. The eyes are partially closed, and the lips are pressed together. The person is wearing a textured cap or head covering, which appears to be fur-lined. The cap extends around the back, creating a voluminous silhouette. The clothing seems to be a heavy garment that wraps around the neck and shoulders. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held by the subject. The background is plain with some cross-hatching. The image maintains an old master-style etching that focuses on the detailed features of the person's face and attire.

artworks.title: Bald Man in a Fur Cloak
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn and Studio of Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of an elderly man, depicted from the shoulders up. His body is turned slightly to the left, in a three-quarter view. The man has a weathered face with visible wrinkles on his forehead and around his eyes, a defined nose, and a downturned mouth. His hair is thinning, revealing balding. He wears a garment with a fur collar. There are no objects or jewelry around him. The background is intricately shaded, and there is a signature and the year "1631" in the upper left corner of the image.

artworks.title: Bald Man with Open Mouth, Looking Down
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn and Studio of Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.description: The etching depicts a man's upper body, focusing on his head and shoulders. The man faces slightly downwards with a hunched posture. His facial features include a prominent nose and textured beard. His head is mostly bald with short, sparse hair around the crown. He wears a garment draping over his shoulders, possibly a robe or cloak, indicated through sketch-like lines. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects. The background is plain, with a signature and date in the upper left corner: "Rembrandt" and "1631."

artworks.title: Bald Man with Open Mouth, Looking Down
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn and Studio of Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.description: The image shows the upper part of a person's body, specifically focusing on the head and upper torso. The person's head is tilted downward. The face is mostly obscured by shadow, with prominent facial features including a distinct nose and a slightly open mouth. The person has a receding hairline, with very little hair on top of the head, and more visible hair around the sides and a beard, depicted through intricately etched lines. They are wearing a garment that drapes over the shoulder, depicted with cross-hatched details indicating folds in the fabric. The background is plain, with signs of wear visible on the textured surface, including faint smudges or spots. There are inscriptions or markings at the top left area.

artworks.title: Bearded Man Looking Down
artworks.description: The etching depicts a man's upper body in a downward-facing position. His head is bent forward. He has a prominent forehead, wide nose, heavily bearded face, and thin, receding hair. He wears a dark garment. There are no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background is plain with cross-hatching.

artworks.title: Sheet of Studies including Head of the Artist, a Beggar Couple, Heads of an Old Man and Old Woman
artworks.description: The image shows a partial etching of a person's face and shoulders, positioned in the upper half of the composition, with the head slightly turned to the viewer's right. The face features curly hair that extends outward, partially shadowing one of the eyes, and a soft expression with faint outlines and shading. The individual wears a wide-brimmed hat which casts shadows across the face. Below the main portrait are sketch-like figures, loosely drawn, suggesting other possible figure studies or incomplete works, with lines crossing and intersecting without definitive features. The background is an unfilled, light-toned space that highlights the etched lines without any detailed context or scenery.

artworks.title: The Persian
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man standing with a walking stick in his right hand. He has a long beard, bushy hair, and wears a hat with a feather. He is dressed in elaborate clothing, including a fur-lined cloak and patterned garment. He wears detailed shoes and a medallion around his neck. The background is minimally sketched.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.description: The image shows three figures. A man and woman are depicted from the waist up, standing close together. The man is on the left and has facial features with a beard and hair covered by a cap. The woman on the right wears a headscarf, looking down at a baby she holds in her arms. The baby's face is visible, wrapped in a cloth. Both adults wear robes with flowing sleeves. To the right, a draped garment or cloth hangs on the wall. The background features cross-hatched patterns for texture and depth.

artworks.title: Turbaned Soldier on Horseback
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a rider on a horse from behind. The person is seated upright on the horse, holding a long stick over their shoulder. The rider's face is not visible, and their clothing appears loose and flowing. The horse's front and hind legs are shown, with its tail drawn in flowing lines. To the left, there are loosely sketched shapes suggesting two additional figures. The background includes minimal details like foliage or trees.

artworks.title: A Cavalry Fight
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an equestrian scene. The drawing features a central figure on a galloping horse. The horse's head is turned upward, and its muscular form is accentuated by the intricate line work. To the left, there is another figure in a defensive pose. The scene is filled with swirling lines and shadows, indicating action and movement, with a tangle of weapons and shields suggesting an atmosphere of conflict. The expressive line work adds a sense of urgency and chaos to the composition.

artworks.title: Beggar in a High Cap, Standing and Leaning on a Stick
artworks.description: The image is a line drawing of a person standing. The individual is hunched forward, leaning on a cane with both hands. They have defined facial features, short curly hair, and are wearing a loose-fitting outfit consisting of a cloak and baggy pants. They also wear a hat and appear to be barefoot. The background is plain with some cross-hatched shading on the lower left side.

artworks.title: Diana at the Bath
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 17.8 × 16.1 cm (7 × 6 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a nude woman sitting with her full body visible, partially submerged in water or positioned on a ledge. Her posture is slightly twisted to the side as she faces the viewer, with her left knee bent and her arms resting on a cloth-covered surface. She has soft facial features with loosely curly hair gathered back, possibly in a bun. She holds a piece of ornate fabric or a garment adorned with intricate patterns and lace in her hands, which drapes over her arms and partly covers her lap. Curvaceous cloth draperies enhance the composition's texture. In the background, there are dense foliage and a large tree trunk creating a natural, enclosed setting. The detailed etching shows the play of light and shadow on her form and the surrounding elements.

artworks.title: The Small Lion Hunt (with One Lion)
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing expressive and dynamic lines in an intense and chaotic scene. The etching portrays a struggle with intricately intertwining forms, suggesting motion and interaction. Detailed cross-hatching creates depth and texture, potentially indicating a violent interaction. The technique used is fluid and expressive, creating strong representation.

artworks.title: The Artist's Mother Seated, in an Oriental Headdress
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly woman from the waist up, seated in a side profile position facing to the right. She has aged features, including wrinkles, a pointed nose, and neutral expression. Her hair is covered with a cap or scarf, and she wears a textured garment. One hand is on her lap, with no visible jewelry. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Bearded Man, in a Furred Oriental Cap and Robe: the Artist's Father
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man's body. His shoulders are turned slightly to the side while his face is directed towards the viewer. The man has a beard and a stern expression. He is wearing a large, furry hat that covers the top of his head, with his hair visible around his temples. He is dressed in clothing with a fur-lined collar. The background is plain, focusing on the subject. The artwork is in monochrome, featuring shading and cross-hatching for texture.

artworks.title: Old Man with Beard, Fur Cap, and Velvet Cloak
artworks.description: The image shows a half-length portrait of an elderly man seated with his body slightly turned towards the viewer. His head is facing forward, displaying a full beard and a serene facial expression with a slightly furrowed brow. His hair, mostly hidden beneath a large, fur-like hat, appears to be bushy and unkempt. The man is dressed in a loose, heavy, fur-lined coat, which covers his shoulders and arms, enveloping him in warmth. One hand rests on top of the other, visible from the coat's opening. In the background, there is a subtle, textured surface devoid of significant detail, focusing all attention on the subject.

artworks.title: The Ship of Fortune
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 11.3 x 16.8 cm (4 7/16 x 6 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a classical figure on horseback near the shore with ships in the background. The artwork depicts a congregation of people, with a central focus on the regal figure on the horse. On the left side, there is a crowd gathered near an ornate architectural structure. The right side shows a boat filled with people, with a figure standing at the prow, guiding the vessel with a firmly hoisted sail. There is a sense of movement and activity throughout, from the figures in animated poses to the rigged sails of the ships in the distance. The line work is intricate and expressive.

artworks.title: Jan Cornelisz. Sylvius
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated, facing slightly to his right. His body is positioned behind a table or desk, and his hands are clasped together on the tabletop, resting on an open book. The man's face is aged, with a prominent, full beard and a receding hairline. His facial expression is serene. He wears a dark coat with a large, frilled white collar peeking out and a closely fitted cap on his head. The background is a textured, cross-hatched design. The focus is entirely on the man and the objects in front of him.

artworks.title: The Angel Appearing to the Shepherds
artworks.description: This print depicts a dark scene with a burst of light in the upper left corner, revealing a tall angel and many cherubs among swirling clouds. The angel faces the right and appears to gesture towards the ground, one hand extended outward. Below, three people are lit by the bright light from above. One of the people is running off to the left, another is kneeling on the ground, leaning back, and the third is standing, arms raised. Two long sticks or canes lay on the ground near them. Animals flee from the patch of bright light, including several large cows, small goats, and sheep with curling horns. More people are visible behind the rushing animals, standing under a large ledge on the right. The background is filled with dark trees that blend into the night.

artworks.title: Christ Driving the Money Changers from the Temple
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a crowded interior scene, depicting a busy marketplace or temple setting with various individuals engaged in different activities. The composition features intricate lines and shading to convey the energy of the environment. The central figure is engaged in a dynamic action, adding to the chaotic atmosphere. The scene is set under a large archway, with tall structures in the background and various goods and livestock scattered around. Dark shadows and highlighted areas enhance the liveliness of the scene, filled with detail and movement.

artworks.title: Christ Driving the Money Changers from the Temple
artworks.description: This is an intricate drawing of a crowded interior space with numerous figures and livestock engaged in a scene of chaos or conflict. The architectural features include prominent arches and streamers on the ceiling, creating a grand setting. The composition is dense, with an elaborate interweaving of lines and textures capturing the tumult and drama of the scenario depicted.

artworks.title: The Great Jewish Bride
artworks.medium: etching, with some drypoint and burin
artworks.description: This print shows a partial view of a woman seen from the waist up. She is positioned facing slightly to the left, with pale skin and long, flowing hair that is spread out down her shoulder and arms. She has high cheekbones, round eyes, and thin lips in a neutral expression. She appears to be wearing a long white garment with a high neck. The bottom half of the print is blank, with a few of the woman's curls reaching down into the blank space. The background in the upper half of the print is a textured surface, possibly a wall, with what look like tall columns on the right. The background of the print is beige paper.

artworks.title: The Great Jewish Bride
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint and burin on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person from the waist up, seated. They have long hair and are dressed in an elaborate garment, holding a rolled piece of paper. The background features detailed shading and architectural elements.

artworks.title: Jan Uytenbogaert
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.3 x 18.3 cm (8 3/4 x 7 3/16 in.)
